recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a later work-group decision intentionally changes Medication's compartment membership, its security categorization, or the compartment-definition guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-7223 was a Published, Persuasive FHIR-core Medication clarification raised against DSTU1. It asked that Medication be distinguished as a master file or knowledge-base resource rather than patient-specific data; the Jira resolution says this was made explicit by the compartment note.
initial_application: Git commit 3be288e561fbfb7b91f0568b3db68023e53784b0 (git-svn build@6453, '@7367 - note about resources not in compartments') added the compartments note naming Medication as a resource not in any compartment, sometimes called a master file, and explaining that Medication itself does not link to a patient while MedicationAdministration connects it to a patient.
additional_context: FHIR-7222 is the broader companion issue about master files versus patient-specific resources and supports using patient/subject links as the distinction. FHIR-8060 independently reworded the same DSTU1 Medication definition sentence, but that wording issue is separate from FHIR-7223's compartment-note resolution. In the current source, Medication and CompartmentDefinition are active in fhir.ini, and Medication is categorized as a business resource rather than patient.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-notes.xml guidance already says Medication is not in any compartment, is among master-file-style resources, and does not link directly to a patient. Repeating the distinction on the Medication page would be redundant and could drift from the authoritative compartment guidance.

related_jiras.note: Broader companion issue explaining that patient-specific resources have patient/subject data and prompting explicit master-file clarification.
Independent Medication definition wording issue on the same DSTU1 sentence; it did not replace the compartment-note resolution for FHIR-7223.
